Message.Name: VCM Trigger Message
Message.Description: The VCM Trigger message is generated whenever a cooling off period is triggered by Volatility Control Mechanism (VCM).

Field.Name: SecurityCode
Field.Description: Uniquely identifies a security available for trading.

Field.Name: CoolingOffStartTime
Field.Description: Time when the cooling off period starts. Nanoseconds since Unix epoch UTC, precision to the nearest second.

Field.Name: CoolingOffEndTime
Field.Description: Time when the cooling off period ends. Nanoseconds since Unix epoch UTC, precision to the nearest second.

Field.Name: VCMReferencePrice
Field.Description: Reference Price for the cooling off period. 3 implied decimal places.

Field.Name: VCMLowerPrice
Field.Description: Lower price in the price band allowed during the cooling off period. 3 implied decimal places.

Field.Name: VCMUpperPrice
Field.Description: Upper price in the price band allowed during the cooling off period. 3 implied decimal places.
